title: The Last Winter
author: Petra Crane
blurb: Gideon Crane, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
